snippet.title: Shroom and Gloom - Facility Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Descend into The Gloom in Shroom and Gloom, a first-person roguelike double-deckbuilder where monstrous mushrooms await and mega-combos rule. Craft two distinct decks: one to explore hand-drawn dungeons, the other to fight fungal foes. Roast, skewer or eat your enemies, upgrade your cards infinitely, and carve your way through bizarre tunnels of madness. The demo is live now. Wishlist the full game on Steam.  ￼

#ShroomAndGloom #DeckbuilderRoguelike #IndieGame
